articleTitle: Anatomization of Fog Computing and Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Today's business revolution depends on digital transformation. Public and private organization's experts forecast the technology which plays a concrete role in their business processes steadfastly. Cloud computing plays a corporeal role in information technology operations to provide a low cost, dexterity, flexibility and scalability. Measureless IoT clients and its applications are urging to execute their business process intelligently and rapidly. Globalized process has been taken place in cloud computing, however this mobilized process is too slow to accommodate the time susceptible tasks [1]. Thus introducing next big computing technology termed as fog computing. The goal of Foggingis to implement the decentralized computing architecture, which distributes data, storage, compute and applications between the data source and the cloud. It outspreads the conception of cloud to the edge of the network and it is closely associated with IoT devices. To bring power to the cloud services, Fog computing scrutinizes and resolves the problem by keeping the data closerto the origin [9]. EdgeComputing empowers the data outcome by IoT devices. This IoT device's process can be processed nearer to itsorigin. By doing this optimized process, long routes data transmission is eluded. Optimized data can be sent to the common data centers or clouds for further process.In this paper, discussed about an extensive similarities and dissimilarities of Cloud, Fog and Edge computing.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Cultural Suitability Index (CSI) for Right Task Allocation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: When a right person is working on a right task with appropriate context, he/she can do wonders. It has always been a challenge to select the most suitable person for a given task. When we are talking about suitability, apart from skills, cultural and behavioral suitability is required to be considered. This paper tries to identify cultural and behavioral properties of individuals along with skills to assess suitability of person for the mission. Paper proposes a new technique using multilevel context based machine learning using expressions and interactions. Suitability of a person for a given task determines how that person contributes to given task and its objectives. The available candidates can be ranked against the task at hand on the basis of suitability index (SI). Learning based on properties of the task as well as behavioral traits of candidates is used here. The algorithm is tested with responses collected for over one thousand candidates with reference to expert opinions and rankings. We have run experiments to compare proposed methods with skill based classification methods.

articleTitle: Wide Power Range Modular Multi-Level Converter for HVDC Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The increase in the High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) technology is growing rapidly and the use of multilevel converter has become a must. However, the increase in the levels of converters leads to complexity. Besides, the interconnection for converting DC/AC/DC to interface renewable systems like solar and wind farm is another issue that should be taken into the account. This paper proposes a high-frequency system for DC/AC/DC/ utilizing lower switching losses modular multilevel converter and alternate arm converters rather than using conventional two or three-level converters. In fact, the DC-link capacitors required for interconnection increases by increasing levels in conventional as well as in proposed converters. Hence, the high- frequency operation is the best solution for a significant reduction in the volume of capacitors and transformers. The proposed 30-MW, 450-Hz converter was verified as having efficient characteristics by simulation using MATLAB.

articleTitle: Commit Time Materialized View Maintenance for Bulk Load Operations in Teradata
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Materialized view is called Join Index (JI) in Teradata. JIs can store tables pre-joined, solely change a table to a different schema or aggregation results. JIs are stored permanently on the disks and cannot be peeped through. Also, their usage or evasion isn't subject to user choice. Teradata optimizer decides when to use a JI, or the underlying table(s) directly from a cost point of view. While the advantage of having JIs is to increase read performance, its downside could be their maintenance. In case of row insertion or modification of an indexed column in base table, JI must be updated. This can create a big performance impact if multiple DMLs within same transaction result in same JI(s) maintenance, bulk load operations for example. On tables with Multiversion Concurrency Control (MVCC), readers and writers work concurrently (Load Isolation in Teradata for example). Readers continue to access the last committed rows while concurrent modifications are happening on the base table(s). JIs defined on multiversioned tables also follow the MVCC principle and continue allowing readers to access the last committed rows. Currently, JIs are maintained immediately with every DML request on base table(s). The proposed approach is to defer the JI maintenance till commit time for MVCC tables, resulting in performance improvement for write operations, as all the JI related operations are performed at the end.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Multiple Output Interleaved Flyback Converter with Post Regulators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This project is aimed at design and implementation of multiple output interleaved flyback converter with post regulators. Interleaved topology reduces the size and cost of power filtering devices but due to high frequency operation of switches in the converter voltage spike across the MOSFET switch is more, so in order to reduce the voltage spikes on MOSFET switch and to increase the efficiency of convert non-dissipative LC snubber is used. In case of multiple output converters achievement of load and cross regulation is major problem. So in order to achieve multiple output requirement with better load and cross regulation, multiple output interleaved flyback converter with post regulators is designed. Low Dropout Regulators (LDO) are used as post regulators. Current mode control technique is implemented to control the width of pulses generated from PWM IC. The converter is operating at a switching frequency of 100 KHz. The proposed converter is miniaturized by using hybrid micro circuit (HMC) technology. Hardware implementation is carried out to validate the design of proposed converter.

articleTitle: Collaboration at Workplace: Technology Design Challenges of Segregated Work Environments
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Modern day job roles require extensive collaboration and peer help among employees at workplace to optimally perform their duties. Inherently, the collaborative work requires extensive coordination mechanisms to improve the collaboration process. The diffusion of technologies in the collaboration process has improved the coordination among actors, however, it requires appropriated technological solutions which are aligned with the work practices of users. In this paper we explore the communication challenges in gender segregated work environments and discuss the design implications for technological systems to better support the collaborative process in such workplaces. Our study highlights how cultural implications, information security and trust are vital elements of effective communication in segregated work environments. Keeping this in view human computer interaction researchers need to design collaborative artifacts which can resolve these issues to enable better collaboration in such settings.

articleTitle: A Survey on Emergency Message Transmission Protocol in VANET with Message Type Recognition: A Modified Neural Network Architecture
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: VANET- Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks get used to broadcast an emergency messages in advance to avoid traffic accidents and traffic congestion between the vehicles. It is very important to deliver the emergency message within right time and to the right or interested vehicles. The protocol is required to get real time information of each and every vehicle on the road then will consider the nearby vehicles and interested vehicles to broadcast the message within the appropriate time. So we proposed the advance Emergency Message Transmission Protocol in VANET with Message Type Recognition: A Modified Neural Network Architecture. It works on Interested vehicles read acknowledgement will further update or rebroadcast message about the current situation for the same basically for daily route vehicle.

articleTitle: Space Filling Miniature Antennas for Multiband Applications Using Split Ring Resonators
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A Moore-Peano fractal antenna is presented in this work for multiband applications. The main objective of this antenna is designed for multiband applications within the Ultra Wideband range. To improve number of frequency bands in Moore antenna, Giuseppe peano fractal implemented on it and size of the antenna can be miniaturized due to its space filling property. On other hand, Split Ring Resonators (SRR) is loaded on Moore-peano fractal antenna to attain more number of bands. Proposed antennas are simulated on FR4 epoxy material using High frequency Structure Simulator tool. In order to enhance the gain and radiation efficiency of proposed structure, Meander Line shape slot is etched and added in ground plane. The overall size of antenna is 25mm x 25mm and applicable for ISM bands, WLAN, S-band, C-band and X-bands.

articleTitle: Classification and prediction of Orthopedic disease based on lumber and pelvic state of patients
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The application of machine learning in the medical field is the trending approach for early prediction and remedy of diseases. The growing number of orthopedic disease has lead people to suffer in an early age and it can be prevented through an early diagnosis. Thus this study pursues to help the medical specialists to predict orthopedic disease early and classify them accordingly. For this purpose, three machine learning algorithms such as Logistic Regression, Random Forest Classifier and k-Nearest Neighbor have been applied to a dataset of 310 patients containing six biomechanical features that describe the state of the patients' pelvic and lumber. The algorithm results are then compared and the one that provided the best result with an accuracy of 89 percent is found to be Random Forest, with other algorithms' accuracy in between 80 to 90 percent.

articleTitle: FCM Scheduled Multiple Model Controller for the Simulated Model of Spherical Tank Process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In this paper, a Fuzzy C Means (FCM) clustering based scheduler has been proposed to assign weights to the local PI controllers in order to achieve control of non-linear process in a wide operating range. The local controller parameters are scheduled through optimum fuzzy membership function obtained using the FCM algorithm. The efficacy of the proposed control scheme is demonstrated by conducting simulation studies on a spherical tank process. The simulation studies depict the crucial role played by the fuzzy clustering in specific number and shape of the membership function selection. Also the simulation studies prove that this methodology is better than a multiple model based PI controllers, whose local controllers are scheduled through fixed triangular membership function.

articleTitle: Modeling, Simulation and Energy-Flow Study of a Battery Electric Vehicle in Labview
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A battery electric vehicle (BEV) uses electric motors and motor controllers powered by rechargeable battery packs. An Electric Vehicle (EV) offers several advantages over conventional petrol/diesel cars as they have sustainable and cleaner energy emissions in transportation and lower running cost. Therefore researchers have keen interest into the mathematical modelling and simulation of a BEV. This paper presents simulation of a BEV in Labview to analyse its power flow and performance. The BEV has a motor, a battery pack, a motor controller and a battery controller; which are modelled as per their mathematical expressions. Simulation is performed and the results are plotted. The torque, power, distance travelled and depth of discharge variations were used to determine the energy flow and performance of EV. This study helps in visualising performance of EV for further research and development.

articleTitle: Optimization of Power System Stabilizer Parameters for Damping of Power System Oscillations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The design problem of an interconnected power system implemented with a power system stabilizer (PSS) can be formulated as a simple optimization problem. This paper describes two systematic approaches to optimization issues by tuning the controller parameters utilizing hybrid HPSS, obtained by combining phase compensation technique with integral of squared error (ISE) criterion and genetic algorithm GPSS with integral of time multiply absolute error (ITAE) technique as objective functions. The two control methodologies have been developed for synchronous machine infinite bus (SMIB) power system. The HPSS and GPSS computes and searches for the optimal parameter settings and simultaneously, enhance the damping of low frequency oscillations and stabilize the system. The transfer functions of the dynamic model, inclusive of excitation system and PSS have been deduced using Mason's graph to evaluate the performance indices and carry out the search processes. Simulations were carried out under different plant conditions employing MATLAB and GEATbx for use with MATLAB. Simulation result shows the viability and effectiveness of the designed methodologies under perturbed and parametric conditions.

articleTitle: Implementation of Floating Point Unit based on Booth Multiplier and Compressor Adder
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: High speed multipliers plays a major role in digital signal processing applications, banking, tax and currency conversions, radar navigation and in real time 3D graphics display. Various techniques have been proposed to design multipliers which are efficient in terms of speed, area and power. Floating point multiplier is better than fixed point multiplier because of wide dynamic range. The floating point multiplier with 3:2 compressor adder and modified booth algorithm is more efficient when compared with other multipliers. Booth technique with compressor adder is used to reduce the partial product in order to increase the speed. This work is implemented in XILINX ISE simulator where the delay and area is improved by 54% and 60.47% in 3:2 compressor adder with modified booth based FPM when compared with compressor adder with modified booth based Floating Point Multiplier, 50% and 40% when compared with compressor adder with Wallace based Floating Point Multiplier and compressor adder based Floating Point Multiplier. Hence speed and area utilized is optimized in 3:2 compressor adder with floating point Multiplier.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent System for Customer Behavior Tracking Using Shoppers’ Path or Traversal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Customer/consumer enters a super market and traverses certain path to buy articles he/she wants. Here consumer/customer is a person who buys a product or service for his personal consumption or use. Can we predict what could be the path followed by customer/consumer and which article he/she is going to buy next? The path followed by consumer is depictive of his behavioral pattern, his likings and needs. Overall path tells us about his buying pattern and can help us to learn about articles he/she is planning to buy. Associations among these traversal paths could help us to predict traversal path of similar customers. This can allow us to suggest personalized paths for customers and also to rearrange articles dynamically based on majority of customers expected on a particular day. This can even help in positioning and sequencing of articles on retail websites. This paper proposes an algorithm for associating traversal paths and consumer psychology to predict behavior of the customer on website or in a particular shop. We have tested our algorithm for five major traversal paths of over 3000 records and 1000 customers from grocery shops. It not only produced encouraging insights but also gave us additional threads for research related to customer path traversal. The algorithm can find many applications in consumer psychology and also in the areas of predicting sales, positioning objects in shops or on websites, etc.

articleTitle: Hybrid Multilayer Receiver based MAC Protocol for Green Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Traditional Wireless sensor networks rely on a limited energy source, mostly batteries. But most applications need nodes to be an autonomous and continuous operation for months or years. Power consumption by sensor node is the most important part of WSN. MAC protocols help in reduction of power consumption which increases the node lifetime. But it can extend the lifetime to a certain point only, finally, we have to replace the battery. Energy harvesting along with the duty cycling come to the rescue, but now the MAC layer needs to be redesigned. In battery-based WSN the major emphasis is on lifetime only but Green Energy harvesting based protocol focus on effective energy utilization and improving the quality of the network. In this paper, new MAC protocol is designed known as Hybrid multilayer receiver initiated MAC protocol customized for the solar energy.

articleTitle: A Simple Method of Solution For Multi-label Feature Selection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Multi-label learning has been a topic of research interest in multimedia, text & speech recognitions, music, image processing, information retrieval etc. In Multi-label classification (MLC) each instance is associated with a set of multiple class labels. Like other machine learning algorithms, data preprocessing plays an key role in MLC. Feature selection is an important preprocessing step in MLC, due to high dimensionality of datasets and associated computational costs.Extracting the most informative features considerably reduces the computational loads of MLC. Most of the Multi-label feature selection algorithms available in literature involve conversions to multiple single labeled feature selection problems. We proposed an efficient modification of a recent multi-label feature selection algorithm [1] available in literature. Our algorithm consists of two steps: in the first step we decompose the output label space into lower dimensions using simple matrix factorization method; subsequently we employ feature selection process in the decoupled reduced space. Our simulations with real world datasets reveal the efficiency of proposed framework.

articleTitle: Hybrid Solar Tracking System: A Brief Overview
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The use of renewable energy source as an alternative source of energy to meet the energy demand has been increasing at a regular pace. The use of solar energy as an alternative source has been increasing due to its availability, and pollution free energy production. The use of Photovoltaic cell (PV) to convert solar energy into electric energy is very less due its less efficiency which is about 12-15%. So to increase the overall output from the PV system, a tracking system is required to track the movement of solar irradiance throughout the day so as to make the solar panel always remain in direct sunlight. A solar tracking though effectively tracks the movement of the sun throughout the day but it suffers when the solar intensity is affected due to critical weather conditions. Hence to overcome such situations a hybrid type racking system can be used which can overcome such situations and can produce better result at its output. Here a basic hybrid solar tracking system along with its control algorithm is describe to give an idea about its functioning and control process. The work presented here shows a tracking system which could effectively produce better result with just the proper utilization of the existing system.

articleTitle: MBS-MIMO Transmitter with Nyquist Subchannel Upsampling
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In [1] a multicarrier enabled subsampling base-band multiple input multiple output system (MBS-MIMO) has been proposed, which provides several advantages over timing interleaved analog-to-digital converters (TI-ADCs) and allows massive parallelization of the digital signal processing (DSP). By choosing discrete multitone (DMT) as its modulation scheme and a hybrid filter bank approach to subdivide the bandwidth into subchannels, it was demonstrated that alias and crosstalk have the same effect and thus can be treated equally. This allows one to apply known MIMO techniques to subsampling as well. This present paper demonstrates how the previously proposed approach can be applied to the transmitter, as well, which has similar advantages. For this purpose, several DMT signals are generated in parallel at a lower rate. To generate a broadband DMT, signal the hold time T<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">hold</sub> at each digital-to-analog converter (DAC) is reduced in order to enhance signal power at higher frequencies. Subsequently, it is filtered and combined. With this method, subcarriers superimposed from different Nyquist zones are already created at the transmitter. Since the same subcarriers are affected when the signal is subsampled at the receiver, the MBS-MIMO receiver can be used without any modification. After deriving the theoretical concept, it is verified with an actual measurement setup.

articleTitle: Towards Building a Better Biometric System Based on Vein Patterns in Human Beings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Until a couple of years ago, lifting fingerprints from photos was considered to be an impossible task. But with all the technological advancements coupled with the ingenuity of hackers, spoofing fingerprint information is not so difficult now. Add to this, the fact that human fingerprints are not always unique, and we see that we need to stop relying heavily on fingerprint-based security systems. So a project that extracts the vein distribution patterns in human palms was devised as a solution to this problem. Biometric identification using IR images of palm vein patterns offers more distinctiveness, robustness and difficulty to plagiarize when compared to similar mechanisms. De-oxidized blood in human veins has a property of absorbing the light rays emitted by an infrared source. This property of IR absorption makes the veins distinctively visible when exposed to IR rays. An image of a human palm is prone to noise when captured under infrared light. Canny's edge detection algorithm was employed on an image dataset where all the images are preprocessed using several steps which will be discussed in detail in the following sections. The detected edges act as authentication information for security systems. A feature extraction algorithm is implemented on these edge-detected images and the result is used to classify the subjects.

articleTitle: Vector Control Method for Induction Motor Drive Based on Hysteresis Controller and PI Controller Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Direct torque control(DTC) scheme is one of the simplest and efficient vector control method. This paper aims to carry out a comparative study of two control methods of DTC. One is conventional DTC scheme based on hysteresis controllers and lookup table. Other method relies on space vector modulation(SVM) algorithm. Lookup table DTC method suffers from high ripples in torque, flux and current as well as varying switching frequency. On the other hand, SVM based DTC produces comparably low torque, flux and current ripples and switching frequency is maintained constant. Simulation of both DTC schemes is carried using MATLAB/Simulink software and the ripple content is estimated.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Convolutional encoder based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This paper focuses on performance analysis of convolution encoder based on FPGA. With the big quantity of applications now a days, that use digital communication to store and retrieve data, this information should sent and received with smallest errors. Forward Error Correction (FEC) schemes unit a necessary an area of wireless communication systems. There square measure several styles of cryptography techniques accustomed correct utterly totally different error. Convolution secret writing methodology, an honest technique used for correcting errors that occur throughout data transmission. A The performance analysis is implemented by using Vivado 2016.1 and Xilinx Simulation. FPGA device used for hardware realization of Convolutional encoder performed with the help of XC7Z020clg4843. Convolutional encoders area unitenforced within the sort of a register style of circuit with explicit locations of the register completely ORed along to supply AN output. The locations that area unit completely ORed along is also mentioned as faucets. The location of those faucets defines potential state transitions wherever the amount of states for a selected code is outlined by 2(L+1). During this case, L is that the length of the register. Using this results in paper it is found that error correcting codes are the best medium to triumph data corruption in digital communication channels.

articleTitle: A Study on the use of State-of-the-Art CNNs with Fine Tuning for Spatial Stream Generation for Activity Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Recurrent neural network (RNN) models have been proven successful in modeling the temporal dynamics in videos of which Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks have been specifically successful as it does not suffer from the vanishing gradient problem. They along with Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for visual feature extraction are popularly referred as the Long-term Recurrent Convolutional Networks (LRCN) and have been widely accepted in the recent times for activities like video activity classification, video captioning and video description. The features for these models may be generated using single spatial stream or dual streams, both spatial and motion streams from the video frames. The paper is a study on how the State-of-the-Art networks like ResNet50, InceptionV3 and MobileNet perform with fine tuning for spatial feature extraction in the task of activity recognition in videos using LRCN with stacked LSTM. The fine-tuning approach and optimization settings for the extraction of the visual features from the State-of-the-Art pretrained networks is also discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Hardware Design of Cascaded Multi-Level Inverter using Multi-Sine PWM Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This paper mainly focusses on the steps for designing cascaded multi-level inverter. The multi-sine pwm technique is implemented which can control the output voltage by varying the amplitudes of two modulating signals. The approach of designing i.e. important features for selecting the controller, bipolar IGBT driver circuit design with an optical isolation, low voltage isolated power supplies for bipolar driver cards and high voltage isolated power supplies for each H-bridge, importance of delay circuit in inverters and design procedure for selecting minimum LC filter size to eliminate harmonics in load as per IEEE-519. The performance analysis and results are verified with MATLAB Simulink and hardware circuit.

articleTitle: Design of Hybrid Standalone Energy System for Village Purtala, India
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The aim of this study is to design a renewable energy based hybrid standalone system to supply rural community of village Purtala in India. The solar radiation data obtained from NASA and wind speed data measured at this site are utilized to analyse this system using HOMER Pro. Diesel generator is used in this system as a backup to ensure the reliability of supply and battery bank is used for storage. The energy system is designed to cater for domestic electricity demand of 25 households of the village. The pattern of load consumption of the rural households of the village is suitably modelled and different combinations of hybrid systems are simulated to identify the optimal system based on least life cycle cost. Results show that system comprised of one 6 kW wind turbine generator, a 10 kW diesel generator, battery array and a converter is the most economically feasible system to supply the load demand. In addition to this sensitivity analyses using diesel prices, solar average radiation and wind speed as sensitivity input variables are also performed in this study.

articleTitle: Underwater Research and Rescue Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A possible solution to minimize the delay in rescuing the coastal areas' ships accident and useful kit for underwater research has been illustrated in this paper. An underwater research and rescue robot has been designed, tested and analyzed for the coast guards and rescue team to save lives. This robot may also be used in research work since Bangladesh has a very large coastal boarder in the Bay of Bengal. Researchers may find this robot useful while doing their research to utilize the resources covered up beneath the Bay of Bengal. However, the robot can also be used in the personal research work. A raspberry pi is used as the communication and control device in this project. Pi camera has been used to get live video streams from the robot to the user. The raspberry pi is directly connected to a router which is in the same network of the central computer via Ethernet cable. User can send command from the computer to raspberry to navigate the robot and also can get the live video stream from the robot. Navigation is controlled by the Brushless motors via Electronic Speed Control (ESC).

articleTitle: Multimodal biometric verification system: Evaluation of various score level fusion rules
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In this paper, biometric verification system is built adopting five physiological traits. We have opted to choose score level fusion, due to its ease in accessing and combining scores generated by different matchers. In our work, we have explored simple transformation rules (min, max, sum), dynamic weighting (DLC, WF) and t-norms (Frank, hamacher and Sugeno weber) score level fusion schemes. All these score level fusion schemes are checked with different desirable parameters such as accuracy, scalability and robustness in declaring the most efficient method for both unimodal and multimodal biometric system.

articleTitle: Design of Luenberger-Type Observers for Damping of Power System Oscillations
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The design of full and minimal-order Luenberger-type observers for asymptotically estimating the states of a single machine infinite bus power system is presented. The estimator uses the system output to provide the estimates of the state information and implements the optimal state feedback control strategy to provide the necessary stabilization and damping to the power system oscillations. The closed-loop pole locations in s-plane are arranged based on symmetrical root locus technique upon the minimization of a quadratic performance index. The observer poles are also placed such that the observer states tracks the system state faster. Computer simulation of two test controllers shows satisfactory performance over wide range of operating conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel Power Management Strategy for Solar-Variable Speed Diesel Generator Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Off grid hybrid energy system is increasingly popular in remote area applications. In this paper demonstrate the Solar-Variable speed diesel generator hybrid energy power system without energy storage element. This setup maintains a strategic distance from the high cost of battery installation and the related complex control. Incorporation of the variable speed diesel generator in to hybrid energy system gives advantages over the conventionally used constant speed diesel generators. Fuel effectiveness and economic operation can be accomplished by variable speed diesel generator. Direct feeding of power from PV and VSDG without cycling through the battery is further increase the efficiency of the system. This paper covered the theoretical analysis, modeling and simulation of Highbrid Energy System with Variable speed Diesel generator. Simulation of the system using MATLAB/Simulink is presented.

articleTitle: Design of non-fragile finite-time l2 - l∞ state estimation for discrete-time switched systems with time delays and sojourn probabilities
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Design of a non-fragile state estimator for a class of discrete-time systems with unreliable communication links is investigated in this paper. Using the technique of sojourn probability, the filter design for the specific subsystem tends to change based on the probability staying in each subsystem. The problem ensures to design a state estimator so that the error system attains stochastically finite-time stability in its mean square with a prescribed l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> - l<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</sub> level by applying Lyapunov functional technique. Finally, the proposed criteria is demonstrated by a numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Harmonics Assessment of a Cascaded H-Bridge Inverter with Carrier Based PWM Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Multilevel Inverters come over the conventional two-level inverter because of their ability to generate better voltage waveform quality at high magnitudes. Because of these qualities, they have been preferred in applications like motor drives, grid- tied applications and FACT applications. While designing an inverter, it is important to choose the proper modulation technique so that the harmonic performance complies with the standard as per the application. In this paper, the existing different types carrier-based PWM techniques have been applied to three-phase H-Bridge inverter. A comparison of THDs obtained from the modulation techniques has been carried out. For each technique, IEEE 519 and IEC 61000-2-2 compliance tests have been presented on the output voltage of individual harmonics. The results evaluated in MATLAB/Simulink environment have revealed that the phase-shifted PWM gives the best harmonic performance. Among the three modulation techniques, the Phase-Shifted PWM presents a superiority over other carrier-based PWMs in all fields of application.

articleTitle: A Novel Multiplicative Substitution Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A cryptosystem primarily used for data encryption and data security. Nowadays the misuse of confidential information by unauthorized parties became a very big issue. Data breach actively increase the necessity of better cryptography algorithms. Various cryptosystems give different levels of encryption. Many encryption methods enhancing security to data. In this paper propose a new cryptosystem called Multiplicative Substitution Cryptosystem (MSC), that encrypts using non-linear functions. This cryptosystem is used to add security for all characters (which also includes extended ASCII characters) where values range from 0 to 255. A non-linear function is used for key whitening. This method uses the same key for both encryption and decryption (symmetric cipher). The Multiplicative Substitution Cryptosystem (MSC) is implemented using python programming. The analysis shows that when compared to other substitution ciphers our multiplicative substitute cryptosystem offers high security, less time complexity, and high throughput.

articleTitle: Review of Modgdf & PNCC Techniques for Features Extraction in Speech Recognition
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In speech recognition system, voice is the main research object. By extracting the features and classifying the speech signal, it will easy to convert voice into text. There are some factors which are affected on accuracy of input signal namely noise, language variability, domain and signal processing as well as on person's language. In this system, we use Arabic language data set because currently most of the research is going on this language. In this system, there are two important phases: feature extraction and classification. For feature extraction phase, we use different techniques like Power Normalized Cepstral Coefficient (PNCC) and Modified Group Delay Function (ModGDF) also for classification we use SVM algorithm. The goal of this paper is to give efficient feature extraction algorithm by comparing PNCC and ModGDF algorithms with SVM and find which technique gives higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Software Component Reusability Classification in Functional Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Reusing the software components can save time, money and resources, and upgrade the quality of the software being developed. Functional paradigm seems to be a platform that can support code reuse better than object-oriented or procedural programming paradigms. This work focuses on identifying potentially reusable components in functional programming paradigm. To conduct the experiments, various software metrics of software components written in Haskell have been used. In this research work, the Self-Organizing Map algorithm is used to cluster the functions from three Haskell packages into three different classes of reusability. Clustering of functions is based on metrics threshold and their average values.

articleTitle: Predictive Analysis of Air Pollution Using Collaborative Filtering Prediction Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Growing trends in Air pollution is possessing threat to environment. Various Researchers have extended their work in predicting air pollution using various predictive analytics. In this paper, we are implementing a predictive model for monitoring air pollution level in different cities of India and publishing it as a web service .The algorithm being used is Collaborative Filtering Prediction Algorithm. A comparison has also been carried out in different predictive analytics mainly using Machine Learning techniques such as regression and Deep Learning Technique and Collaborative filtering technique.

articleTitle: Design of Multiband Planar Antenna by using Mirror Image of F Shaped with Inverted U Shaped and Modified Ground Plane
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The proposed antenna designed with mirror image F shaped and inverted U shaped on patch with modified ground plane. The presented antenna is covered the frequency ranges (2.4-2.504GHz),(3.24-3.785GHz) and(5.112-6.016GHz) for WLAN /Zigee/Bluetooth/WiMAX and HYPERLAN applications.The size of planar antenna is 39.5×13mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> which is easily comfortable with small portable device like mobile handsets and laptop computers etc. .The more than two band facilities is implemented in this designed antenna for several applications. After fabrication of designed antenna is measured using Vector Network Analyzer (VNA) to analysis the simulated and measured result .

articleTitle: Imbalanced Data Using with-in Class Majority Under Sampling Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The existing data can be further processed by using data mining techniques for novel discovery of knowledge. Classification is one of the techniques used for knowledge discovery. One of the most popular models used for knowledge representation is decision trees due to its easy of interpretation. Class imbalance data sources are of the critical and most popular data sources for their real time availability. The existing classification techniques are bottle necked in the scenario for skewed distributed data. To address his short coming, we have proposed a novel algorithm With In class Majority Under Sampling (WIMUS) for improved learning. The results generated are encouraging to show that our proposed approach is effective on class imbalance data sources.

articleTitle: Efficient MUX Based CORDIC on FPGA for Signal Processing Application
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This paper presents the high speed and area achieved using the Coordinate Rotation Digital Computer (CORDIC) algorithm for digital signal processing applications. There are many efficient algorithms for CORDIC, these algorithms there is shifters, adders, and subtractors for sine/cosine wave generation. In this paper proposed multiplexers based CORDIC algorithm. Multiplexers based Coordinate Rotation Digital Computer algorithm used to achievethe fast and efficient hardware on FPGA. A six-stage Coordinate Rotation Digital Computer is achieved by three arrangments proceeding by unrolled CORDIC and MUXes based CORDIC up to three stages, MUXes based CORDIC up to the fourth stage with and without pipelining. The proposed architecture for CORDIC adders, subtractors, and shifters, all are replaced by multiplexers up to the third stage and fourth stage. An 8bit and16-bit Coordinate Rotation Digital Computer to achieving the sine functions and cosine functions perform all methods on Xilinx Spartan 3E (XC3S250E) and Xilinx Virtex6 FPGA(XC6VLX240). Compared with the unrolled CORDIC MUXes based CORDIC achieves the high operating frequency and less area requires for hardware implementation.

articleTitle: Improving BER of WiMAX using Interference Mitigation Techniques
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: New Generation Wireless Networks is still confront the disputes such as resource sharing, channel or bandwidth allocation, synchronization, spectrum efficiency, and interference a major concern among all. Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) is a prevailing technology that is widely adopted by current 4G and 5G wireless communication as it can certainly resolves many issues of wireless networks such as data rates and interferences. The paper introduces three types of interferences - Inter Symbol Interference (ISI), Inter Carrier Interference (ICI), and Co- Channel Interference (CCI) that greatly clog our Bit Error Rate (BER). This paper had taken World Wide Interoperability for Microwave Access (WiMAX) as our 4G wireless application that works with OFDM and try to reduce its BER by using interference mitigation techniques such as Wavelet and Space Time Block Code (STBC). Furthermore, WiMAX physical layer is described with its interferences and relevant solution, also the advantage of Wavelet transform in contrast to Fourier transform and its comparison is shown in terms of BER.

articleTitle: RF Energy Harvesting System Using Monopole Antennas
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: We are surrounded by the radio waves just like the light around us. Our phones, laptops, routers, satellites, antennas almost everything around us emits radio waves. With increasing pollution, it is necessary to use a greener way to harvest, conserve and use energy. The readily available RF (Radio Frequency) waves are the best way to do it. Though the output voltage is not enormous but it can still be amplified and used for several applications for daily use. It might also be helpful when the renewable sources are unavailable. This paper focuses on RF energy harvesting system using monopole antenna that can be applied to various wireless sensor network applications (WSNA). These include different monitoring, sensing and detection systems. Different types of monopole antennas are designed, manufactured, tested and were studied.

articleTitle: Surface Charging and its Influence on Lightning Impulse Flashover Characteristics of Polymeric Insulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Surface charges accumulated on the polymeric insulating materials play a crucial part in determining the performance of those materials. This paper presents the mechanism of surface charge accumulation on polymeric insulator and its influence on flashover voltage of the insulator under positive polarity lightning impulse voltages. The needle- plane electrode geometry is used to simulate the surface charge production and accumulation mechanisms due to corona. Later, the identified charge distribution with known charge density is pre-deposited in the various locations of the sample insulator with a single weather shed and lightning impulse flashover voltage is computed using streamer criteria. The flashover characteristics show a strong dependency on polarity, magnitude and location of the surface charges. The computed results are evaluated based on electric field distribution and the flashover voltage computation method is validated with experimental results.

articleTitle: Frequency Regulation By Doubly Fed Induction Generator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Conventional generators which provide frequency regulation in power systems are getting replaced by renewable sources. So in a system which is penetrated by Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS), we need to think of providing frequency regulation features in the WECS itself. In this paper Doubly Fed Induction Generator (DFIG) is deloaded to provide power reserve. A controller is designed which make use of this reserve to meet the changing load demand. Proposed system validated through MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: Thumb Controlled Low-Cost Prosthetic Robotic Arm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Not everyone is gifted with perfect limbs. There are people in this world who lose their precious body parts in accidents or diseases. They are also not up to speed with the staggering development of technology and productivity. To solve this issue, the area of prosthetic limbs has been widely explored since its inception. However, the existing solutions are financially out of the reach for general people of developing countries. In this paper, a low-cost robotic arm has been proposed which is affordable to above or below elbow amputees. Using servo motors, Arduino UNO, end effector etc. to construct the proposed system can enable a person to move, grasp and replace objects that are heavy or require both hands to carry. A prototype of the model has been made to show the efficiency, productivity and cost analysis of the proposed system. The result displays that the system is cost-effective and affordable to the poverty-stricken section of the community.

articleTitle: A Case study of MW-Mile, MVAr-Mile, MVA-Mile and Power Factor based Transmission Pricing in Integrated Nepal Power System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This paper uses the MW-Mile method, MVA-Mile method and MVAr-Mile method for transmission system costing along with the use of power factor based approach. This particular example here is dealing with a special case of 132kV and 66 kV transmission systems of Integrated Nepal Power System ( INPS ). A 51-bus system of INPS considered in this study is observed through multiple load flow analysis to evaluate the base case transmission pricing and transmission pricing due to incremental power drawn by individual loads at the specified buses. Based on this incremental power, incremental loss and power factor change, the transmission pricing in different states has been evaluated and analyzed. Hence, this paper considers MW-Mile based, MVA-Mile and MVAr-Mile based incremental cost of power demand addition along with power factor based approach. Also, DC load flow based transmission costs is also studied during which, both loss based and flow based transmission costs are evaluated and analyzed.

articleTitle: A Multi-Tiered Alert Mechanism for Intrusion and Disaster Prevention in a Smart Home Scenario
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Today we are living in a world where smart homes are highly prevalent. Such homes involve many smart devices to form an Internet of Things (IoT) structure and huge amounts of data are generated. Efficient transmission of these data is vital since they may contain security related information also. The resident of the smart homes should be notified about any intrusions or emergencies such fire accidents when they are away from the home. In this paper, we propose a mechanism based on Wi-Fi 802.11b where various types of data traffic are considered which detects the intrusions and the emergencies in a smart home based scenario. Here alerts are sent to the resident through a cloud server. A multi-tiered detection and data transmission system is designed to improve the efficiency of the alert mechanism.

articleTitle: Investigation Study on Virtual Community Formation in Social Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A social network (SN)permits the people with same interests to distribute the information, photos and videos. The person who connects on SN sites as personal effort interacts through different media to discuss the interests. The social networks are employed for familiar interaction. A virtual community is a SN with group of individuals who communicate through social media, crossing the geographical and maintaining the boundaries to track the mutual interests. Virtual communities are used for different social and professional groups where communication between community members changes from one individual to another. But, the existing techniques failed to group the similar behavior peoples to form the virtual community. In order to address the problems, the machine learning and ensemble learning techniques are introduced to form the virtual community based on influencing, suspicious and trust behavior with better classification accuracy and lesser time consumption.

articleTitle: Wearable ECG Electrodes for Detection of Heart Rate and Arrhythmia Classification
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Continuous monitoring of Electro Cardio Gram (ECG) for long term in our living environment provides the necessary information for preventing the heart attack and other cardiac diseases. Real-time wearable ECG monitoring system with related cardiac arrhythmia classification of stepwise algorithms is implemented in this paper. But some disadvantages of those methods were hindered by the movements. The chips also have some restriction to detection of cardiac rates. For monitoring the status of heart we have a fully reconstructed wearing ECG module which is a medical friendly device for identifying these defects. Our device is less in weight and has reduced power consumption, long battery lifetime of one month to make the device suitable for primary care applications. Two metal electrodes have been used in this device activated by the user for the potential difference calculation across the wrists. The flexible ink has been used in the manufacture of electrodes and cannot be more difficult for pasting on the module case, designed for companion to all the users and can be adaptable for different shapes. On the R-R interval (peaks) basis calculation, the heart rate can be displayed in Beats Per Minute (BPM). The normal or abnormal condition (Tachycardia, Bradycardia ) of the heart can be found by the above criteria.

articleTitle: Comparison of Token-Based Code Clone Method with Pattern Mining Technique and Traditional String Matching Algorithms In- terms of Software Reuse
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Code clones have a great impact on software. Detecting them has become a challenge among software industries. Code clones are mostly found in large-scale applications. There are many techniques available to detect them. Most of them are sophisticated, expensive and also difficult to implement. The detected clones are eliminated without further investigation. Careful analysis of code clones will aid in software reuse. In this paper, a generic architecture of token-based code clone reuse method which assists software reuse is proposed. It detects type-1 i.e. exact clones and type-4 i.e. functional clones and also helps in software reuse. Its performance is compared with traditional string matching technique and FP-Growth technique. Evaluation of the three types of algorithms is done based on six open source software. The results show that the proposed method can find more number of functional clones when compared to other techniques. This analysis will pave way for introducing new concepts based on fundamental logics.

articleTitle: Study of Stability Analysis using Lyapunov Function for IEEE-9 Bus System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In the present work, IEEE 9 bus has been studied, and its stability is estimated via kinetic energy at critical clearing time. In power system, instability is the main reason, which disturbs the main characteristics of the system of multi-machine such as synchronism, critical clearing time of fault, etc. In the given system, faults disrupt the rotor-angle stability, resulting un-synchronism in the machines. The parameters rotor-angle, speed and kinetic energy are estimated with the help of Lyapunov function and the Newton-Raphson method to obtain the stability limits of the system. The detection of stability is improved significantly near to stability limit with the help of kinetic energy, and it is verified by the simulation results.

articleTitle: Wideband Design of C-shape Microstrip Antenna Using Rectangular Slot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Novel compact design of C-shape microstrip antenna with rectangular slot along the C-shape patch length is proposed. Second order TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">20</sub> mode is reduced in its frequency due to rectangular slot and because of optimum separation with reference to TM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> mode, yields wide band characteristics in C-shape patch. The compact design offers bandwidth of 70 MHz (> 8%) and exhibits pattern maxima in broadside direction with peak gain of 7 dBi. Formulation in resonating length for modes in C-shape patch with slot is presented. It gives closer prediction with the simulated frequencies. To validate formulations, methodology to design C-shape antenna with slot is presented at different frequency which shows similar wideband characteristics. Thus compact design of C-shape patch with slot supported by its detailed study to highlight resonant mode based antenna functioning along with resonant length formulation followed by design procedure, are all the novelties in the present paper.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of a Wheeled Mobile Robot in Open-Loop Control
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: In this paper a kinematic and dynamic model of a two wheel differentially driven mobile robot is presented. The kinematic model is obtained by applying co-ordinate frame transformation between different frames of mobile robot. A hexagonal platform is mounted robot. The dynamic model of the robot is developed using classical Newton-Euler approach. The dynamics of the actuators are developed using KVL and KCL laws. The integrated kinematic and dynamic model is developed using SCILAB software. To validate the model, simulation is performed for straight and curved trajectory. From the simulation result the proposed model can be effectively simmulate the differentially driven mobile robot.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Different Level Modular Multilevel Converters
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This paper deals with the comparison of the different output levels of three phase modular multilevel converter [MMC]. The analysis of three level, five level and nine level MMC is performed by considering THD (total harmonic distortion) of output voltage and current with 2N+1 level PD-PWM switching strategy. Simulation of all levels of MMC is done in MATLAB/SIMULINK and the results are presented. It is found that THD of voltage and current are less in 9 level MMC. In addition, prototype of the three level MMC with redundant switching is developed in the laboratory and results are presented.

articleTitle: A Quasi-Ballistic Drain current model with Positional Scattering Dependency applicable for Nanoscale DG MOSFETs
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: This work presents a simple physics based quasi-ballistic drain current model applicable for nanoscale Double Gate (DG) MOSFETs. The proposed model is physical and includes both drift-diffusion and ballistic transport phenomena. The model considers scattering effects that occur in real nanoscale devices, in terms of transmission and reflection co-efficients related to scattering theory. The results obtained in the proposed work provide an intuitive analysis and signify the positional scattering dependency at the critical layer near the low field source region on the drain current characteristics. An insightful and comparative analysis is done for the proposed quasi-ballistic model, with a hypothetical complete ballistic device and a velocity saturated short channel DG MOSFET model.

articleTitle: Smart Health Care Monitoring System By Seven Segment Image Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Health care monitoring (HCM) is an innovation to empower observing of patients outside of traditional clinical settings, which may build access to mind and reduction medicinal services conveyance costs. In order to proper recovery, monitoring a patient’s medication and health condition is mandatory. In daily life, it is very common that patients forget about taking their antibiotics on time and for that they have to start their medication course again. Moreover, in the hospital nurses sometimes cannot give the patient, medicine on time and do other checkups because of work load. In terms of emergency patients, we believe a single minute matter. We are proposing a model where patients will be able to set up their medication time. On time they will be alerted to take medicine. Moreover, we are using pulse sensor and body temperature sensor. These sensors will take reading automatically from the patient on time. After that, all these records will be saved in a text file and doctor will be able to check from his chamber anytime he wants through remote wireless connectivity with our system.

articleTitle: Malicious node detection in VANET Session Hijacking Attack
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Vehicular Adhoc Networks (VANETs) consists of lot of or thousands of moving nodes. Maintaining network topology and protecting every node from attack is not practical. Malicious nodes might behave like legitimate vehicle by selectively dropping the packet and it is essential to detect their malicious nature. Entire operation of the VANET gets disturbed. This paper primarily focuses on detecting the malicious node that pretends to be a legitimate vehicle throughout the session hijacking attack in VANETs and also discusses on the throughput, delay at end points, total counts of packet generated, exchanged and dropped using the Network Simulator-2 (NS2) tool and appropriate inference provided.

articleTitle: Stereotypic Repetitive Hand Flapping Movement Detector for Children with Autism
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The prevalence of autism spectrum disorder (asd) has increased at a significant rate in recent years, especially in developed nations such as the united states, japan, and south korea. Children affected with autism tend to exhibit a spectrum of symptoms depending on the severity of the disease. These behaviors are primarily repetitive, self-stimulatory, and stereotypic behaviors such as hand flapping (i.e., repeatedly shaking their hands), body rocking (i.e., swaying their body back and forth), drumming, walking around in a confined space, and walking with shortened steps on toes, etc. in this research project, a simple reminder system is proposed using wearable sensors to automatically detect significant hand flapping movements. The reminder system consists of a speaker encoded with the voice of mother, father, or any other custom designed voice. an algorithm was designed to trigger the audio device when the child showed significant hand flapping activity (i.e., hand flapping more than 10 times) within a given time frame. the time frame and the hand flapping count can be customized per severity of the child's symptoms. The device was successfully tested in the laboratory by simulating the hand flapping movement shown by the child. It is hoped that this system provides a valuable service to parents and the child by alerting the child to autistic movements, preventing the habit from turning into self-injurious behavior, and taking away the burden from parents and caregivers.

articleTitle: A power management scheme for a standalone solar PV system utilizing super lift Luo converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A power management scheme for a solar standalone solar PV system employing dual input, single output Luo converter operating under deficit PV power condition has been proposed. The dual input Luo converter is used to interface a solar PV module and a battery to provide power to a standalone DC load. A power management scheme integrates MPPT and voltage control and modulates power flow from solar PV and battery to supply the power demanded by the standalone DC load. The complete system is modeled and simulated to observe the dynamic behavior and verify the working of the system.

articleTitle: Fractional order PID controlled Quadratic-Boost-Converter - Multilevel inverter fed Induction Motor System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: A QBC (Quadratic-Boost-Converter) for -MLI (Multilevel-inverter) fed IM (Induction Motor) (QBCMLIIM) is proposed here. Quadratic boost-converter with multilevel-inverter is an alternative system in between the DC source and the motor. This work proposes quadratic boost converter between the DC source and inverter. The proposed effort considers closed- loop response of QBCMLI (Quadratic- boost-converter multilevel-inverter)-system accompanied by PI and Fractional-Order-PID-controllers (FOPID). The objective of the proposed system of converter is to sustain steady-speed of the induction- motor-drive circuit-modules is expanded for PI& FOPID-controlled-systems. The mat lab outcome attained illustrates a developed dynamic-performance by using FOPID-controlled QBCMLIIM system. The experimental results of QBCMLIIM-system are compared with those of simulation-ones.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Brain Tumor from MRI Images using Fast Marching Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: The brain tumor is caused when there is uncontrolled growth of cells in the brain. There are two types of tumor, Malignant and Benign. With malignant being the cancerous type and spreads to other regions. Segmentation of brain tumor for further medical analysis is very important. With the recent advancements in the field of medical image analysis and computer vision, the process of segmentation is implemented using computer-aided systems. In this paper, a gradient-based Fast Marching method is used for segmenting the brain tumor. The segmented and extracted images were compared with the ground truth image and dice similarity was calculated for the evaluation of the segmentation algorithm. The images were preprocessed for the removal of noise and contrast-enhanced for better interpretation of the image. PSNR, MSE, SSIM were the parameters calculated for the analysis of image quality.

articleTitle: Power Conditioner For Voltage Sag/Swell and Harmonic Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)
abstract: Electrical traction is as environmental friendly, pollution-free and energy efficient mode of transport and offers an excellent alternative to fossil fuels as a source of energy. Indian Railways are the world's largest transportation sector. Presently 37.65 percentage (Indian Railway statistical Publication 2016-17) of total route kilometers have been electrified by Indian Railways. Under heavy traffic, overloading on a finite section of transmission line with multiple locomotive loads yields to a dip in transmission voltage below the rated voltage of locomotive load and an inefficient operation of motor takes place if the system is operated with this under voltages. AC railway traction systems are also susceptible to harmonic distortion. A compensation scheme to improve voltage profile and current harmonic mitigation of Indian Railway traction system is proposed in this paper. The power conditioner is used for effective switching can control the harmonics too. A novel power conditioner is introduced which functions both as a DVR and APF to effectively control the voltage sag/swell and harmonic in the 25 kV traction line. In this paper, the unit vector generation control strategy is used to generate current and voltage references for compensation and control. The unit vector generation strategy utilizes low pass filters to separate the reactive and harmonic content in the load current. The simulation studies showed good results with the voltage sag/swell compensation and reactive current compensation giving almost ideal result of near unity power factor and harmonic currents getting compensated. Thus this will offer a solution to the problems faced with traction loads.

articleTitle: A Novel DDoS Detection Mechanism: Trust based Approach
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Electrical, Computer and Communication Technologies (ICECCT)

authors.preferredName: B K S P Kumar Raju Alluri
authors.firstName: B K S P Kumar Raju

abstract: DDoS attacks have caused major problems in modern Internet from the past few decades. With the development of emerging technologies, attackers can launch numerous DDoS attacks with a lower cost. Thus it is much harder to detect and prevent DDoS attacks. To defend against these attacks, one critical issue is to effectively isolate the attack traffic from the legitimate traffic. A novel DDoS detection mechanism based on trust score calculation is proposed in this paper. The trustiness on the node is taken as the base reference to distinguish the attack prone traffic from absolutely normal ones. Then we further segregate the malicious traffic to the finer level by considering various network parameters and methods.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Power Flow With Improving Voltage Stability and Loss Minimization Using Moth Flame Optimization Algorithm
